ValidationRule.description: Current User cannot change the Approval result until he/she a member of Credit Approval Queue for Credit Limit greater than 1000 and Approval Matrix need to match
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(Region_Flag__c) =='Bahrain', ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Approval_Result__c), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(cc_Credit_Approval_Result__c))), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Cash Collateral Application"), ISPICKVAL( Type , "Cash Collateral Credit Limit Increase Application") ), (cc_Approved_Credit_Limit__c > 1000), OR( NOT($Permission.Ability_to_Approve_Cash_Collateral_Cards), ($User.cc_Can_Approved_Cash_Collateral_Cards__c = false) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change the Credit Approval result. Please contact the Administrator
